The founder

Behind every shift, a name.

The company carries the name of its founder, Christos Mellios — and that is a promise, not a label.

With more than 25 years in private security, Christos Mellios knows that a client never buys “just guarding”. You trust us with your property, your business and your people — and that trust is earned on every single shift.

That is why contact stays direct and personal: the mobile line answers 24 hours a day, and every collaboration starts with a conversation about what your premises really need.

ProfessionalismTrained staff and clear procedures on every site.
ReliabilityWhat we agree is what happens — at 3 p.m. and at 3 a.m.
Rapid responseOne phone call, and a patrol is on its way.

Our services

Security services that never sleep.

From port terminals and logistics yards to offices, hotels and homes: static guarding, patrols, camera monitoring and rapid response, designed around your premises.

Static guarding

Trained guards on site for port and container yards, warehouses, logistics centres, industrial plants and construction sites — with access control, entry logs and perimeter checks.

PortsLogisticsIndustry

Patrols on & off site

Marked patrol cars and a motorbike check your premises at irregular hours, day and night — inside the perimeter and around it — so nobody can predict the next visit.

Day & nightMarked vehicles

Rapid response 24/7

An alarm signal or a phone call puts a patrol on its way. We check the premises, inform you on the spot and stay until the situation is safe.

Alarm signals24/7

Camera monitoring (CCTV)

Live monitoring of your cameras for homes and businesses, combined with patrols: what the camera sees, a guard can check in person.

HomesBusinesses

VIP protection

Discreet protection and escort for executives, artists and visitors — with route planning, venue checks in advance and a low profile when it is needed.

EscortDiscretion

Hotels, marinas & homes

Discreet but effective security for hotels, marinas and yachts, villas and residential complexes — so your guests and your family feel safe without noticing us.

TourismVillas

Which areas do you cover?
All of Attica: central Athens, Piraeus and the ports, the northern, southern and eastern suburbs, and West Attica with its industrial zones. Patrol zones are planned per area.
Are you available 24 hours a day?
Yes. The mobile line 699 643 6197 answers 24 hours a day, every day of the year — for emergencies, alarm signals and new requests.
How quickly can a patrol arrive?
It depends on the area and the kind of cover you choose. We tell you clearly from the start what to expect for your premises — before you decide.
Do you guard ports, warehouses and logistics centres?
Yes. Container yards, terminals, warehouses, logistics centres, industrial plants and construction sites are a big part of our daily work: static guarding, perimeter patrols, access control and camera monitoring.
Do you protect homes and villas?
Yes — homes, villas and residential complexes, with patrols, camera monitoring and rapid response when an alarm goes off.
Do you offer VIP protection?
Yes. Discreet protection and escort for executives, artists and visitors, with route planning and venue checks in advance.
How much does it cost?
The price depends on the premises, the hours and the kind of cover. Call or email us: we discuss your needs and send you a clear offer.
How do we start?
With one phone call to 699 643 6197 or an email to info@christosmellios.gr. We talk about your premises, agree the cover and the shift plan, and start.
